auth_details: No auth for ordinary public REST endpoints. Exception: getProprietaryInformation may require a UMLS UTS API key via Authorization: Bearer for restricted source vocabularies.
free_tier_limits: Free of charge; online usage limited to 20 requests/second per IP address. No paid plan is offered.
rate_limits: Maximum 20 requests/second per IP address; excess requests may not be serviced. NLM recommends caching results for 12–24 hours.
resolution_notes: auth.details: auditor right — official getProprietaryInformation docs state a UMLS UTS API key may be sent as Authorization: Bearer for restricted sources (https://lhncbc.nlm.nih.gov/RxNav/APIs/api-RxNorm.getProprietaryInformation.html). free_tier_limits: auditor right — ToS: APIs free-of-charge, ≤20 req/s/IP, no paid tier (https://lhncbc.nlm.nih.gov/RxNav/TermsofService.html). rate_limits: auditor right — same ToS limit plus 12–24h cache guidance; ToS says excess may not be serviced (not specifically HTTP 429).
